summary: Authored and landed the three locked DOCS flow specs, their canonical run_flow RED proofs (captured against the recorded preimplementation source at planning SHA 38034e97 via a historical-checkout --root run; twelve functional assertion failures, no infrastructure failures), and the AC-4 claim ledger. FLOW-DOCS-01-getting-started-engine-decision passes 12/12 across chromium-desktop/mobile/nojs (orientation bodies, single engine question and TabGroup, both complete conversation commands inside their panels, transport search to the boundary page, authored 404 recovery, ledger plus real snippet/single-tutorial/dist-link gate subprocesses). FLOW-DOCS-01-theming-and-section-nav passes 9/9 (>=20 paired oklch token rows, distinct --primary pair, scoped engine guidance verified against apps/example/global.css and lib/theme.ts, seam anchors verified against current registry sources, section navigation, no-JS reading floor). FLOW-DOCS-02's content cases and reading floor pass, and its heavyweight invocation executes real fresh public installs: five of six seed legs pass on real devices (both engines, iOS + Android, both appearances, plus the nativewind web export and the callback-disconnection negative control), but the uniwind/web leg is deterministically blocked by react-native-web@0.21.3 (published 2026-09-25T15:00Z, after ORI-RN-003's committed green) dying inside uniwind 1.11.0's incomplete package.json exports map during expo export; reproduced standalone twice and pinned 0.21.2 exports cleanly, so the one-line fix lives in packages/docs-snippets/*/package.json (outside this task's writeAllowed) and the flow fails closed per contract, leaving the per-engine live matrices owed to the rerun. One content correction landed: owns-vs-does-not-own.md no longer claims the example lacks a live streaming chat and now links the verified run guide apps/example/docs/live-chat.md.
assumptions: RED base = the task's declared planning Source SHA 38034e97 (the recorded preimplementation source); the three flow specs were copied into a clone of that SHA and run_flow --root captured the proofs; the canonical proof.red files carry head=38034e97+dirty lineage headers.

The heavyweight Quickstart test applies the env hygiene the owning tasks established (delete NODE_ENV, short reaper-free TMPDIR) before importing the RN driver in-process — without it the Playwright worker's NODE_ENV=test breaks expo install and Metro serving to Expo Go.

The Expo Go 57.0.9 APK was restored to the driver's hardcoded cache path by pulling the genuine artifact from the reserved emulator (same versionCode 444); the agent-scratch reaper had deleted the original.

Driver output directories (tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-RN-003/** and the would-be ORI-AI-002 refresh) plus FLOW-SHELL-15/16 run.json were rewritten by real runs in this worktree but are NOT committed — outside writeAllowed; they remain dirty for their owners/the orchestrator.

FLOW-DOCS-02's run.json records exit 1 with the 5/6 seed state; its testFile hash predates a post-run biome format-only autofix of the spec (flows 1 and 2 were canonically replayed after the autofix and their hash bindings are exact).

Prior-sprint verification: the vitest logic lanes fail extensively on main itself (verified on the primary checkout: SHELL-010 copy contract, SHELL-006 trio, SHELL-002, plus the contracted destructive src/data cases), so those failures are pre-existing and routed to their owners; the prior browser lanes also fail on this candidate (same SHELL-010-class content assertions, destructive-case data deletion, and mid-run server loss) but a main-side browser baseline could not be completed due to heavy sibling contention on port 4321 throughout the evening.

Port 4321 discipline: only previews serving this worktree were killed; foreign listeners (primary checkout and FIX-ORI-SUITE-1 worktree) were waited out, and final canonical replays ran with CI=true so Playwright owned its server.
blockers: FLOW-DOCS-02-quickstart-chat-screen sixth seed leg (uniwind/web): react-native-web@0.21.3 (published 2026-09-25T15:00Z) adds an InputAccessoryView export that uniwind 1.11.0's package.json exports map cannot resolve (it points at dist/module/components/web/InputAccessoryView.js, which the uniwind tarball does not ship), so `expo export --platform web` fails inside every fresh uniwind consumer under `~0.21.0`. Deterministic across two flow attempts plus a standalone reproduction; pinning react-native-web@0.21.2 in the same consumer exports with exit 0. Fix owner: the RN/template tasks (packages/docs-snippets/{nativewind,uniwind}/package.json is outside this task's writeAllowed). After the pin lands, rerunning this task's locked command completes the seed matrix and executes the per-engine live matrices in the same invocation (the spec already awaits runQuickstartProof and run-live-example-proof.mjs unchanged).
